# Reference: classification vocabularies

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_reference_docs.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every enum used to classify a use case, a capability, a deployment, or a supply arrangement. Members are listed in declaration order; where an enum is ordered, that order is meaningful and rules compare against it.

## Capability classification

### `TransformationClass`

What the capability does to the media, in increasing order of novelty.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `EXTRACTION` | 0 |
| `CONVERSION` | 1 |
| `ENHANCEMENT` | 2 |
| `REPAIR` | 3 |
| `MODIFICATION` | 4 |
| `SYNTHESIS` | 5 |

### `ControlMode`

How much of the operation the user defines, in increasing order.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `PRESET` | 0 |
| `PARAMETERIZED` | 1 |
| `CONDITIONED` | 2 |
| `COMPOSED` | 3 |

### `FinalPixelRole`

Whether and how the output reaches the delivered work.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `NONE` | 0 |
| `REFERENCE_ONLY` | 1 |
| `COMPOSITED_ELEMENT` | 2 |
| `DELIVERED_FRAME` | 3 |

### `LikenessPresence`

How a performer is present in the output.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `NONE` | 0 |
| `AESTHETIC` | 1 |
| `VOICE` | 2 |
| `PERFORMANCE` | 3 |

## Use case intake

| --- | --- |
| `INTERNAL_TESTING` | Internal testing |
| `INTERNAL_PRODUCTION` | Internal production use |
| `PUBLIC` | Public-facing |

## Operational characteristics

### `HostEnvironment`

Where the AI executes, ordered by decreasing customer control.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `ON_DEVICE` | On-device |
| `ON_PREMISES` | On-premises |
| `CUSTOMER_CLOUD` | Customer-controlled data centre or cloud |
| `VENDOR_CLOUD` | Vendor-controlled data centre or cloud |

### `UpdateControl`

Who decides when the deployed version changes.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `CUSTOMER` | Customer-controlled rollout |
| `VENDOR` | Vendor-controlled rollout |

### `Custodian`

Who has operational control over inputs and outputs.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `USER` | User (the artist operating the tool) |
| `CUSTOMER` | Customer organization |
| `VENDOR` | Tool vendor |

### `CollectionPolicy`

Whether the vendor collects something, and whether you can decline.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `NOT_COLLECTED` | Not collected |
| `COLLECTED_OPT_OUT` | Collected, opt-out available |
| `COLLECTED_REQUIRED` | Collected, no opt-out |

### `RefinementLocation`

Where customer-driven model refinement happens, if it is supported.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `NOT_SUPPORTED` | Not supported |
| `CUSTOMER_CONTROLLED` | Customer-controlled data centre or cloud |
| `VENDOR_CONTROLLED` | Vendor-controlled data centre or cloud |

## Tool and model sourcing

### `AIPosture`

How a vendor obtains the AI it ships.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `OWN_MODELS` | Provides its own models |
| `CUSTOMIZES_THIRD_PARTY` | Customizes third-party models |
| `OPEN_SOURCE_MODELS` | Uses open-source models |
| `RELIES_ON_AI_SERVICES` | Relies on other AI services |

### `Packaging`

How the tool is delivered as a single unit.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `DESKTOP_SOFTWARE` | Desktop software |
| `SAAS` | SaaS |
| `API_SERVICE` | API-driven service |
| `PLUGIN` | Plug-in |
| `PIPELINE_NODE` | Node for node-driven workflows |
| `WORKFLOW_PLATFORM` | Workflow platform |
| `MODEL_ROUTER` | Model aggregator or router |

### `Separability`

Whether individual AI capabilities can be governed independently.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `CUSTOMER_CONFIGURABLE` | Customer can enable or disable per capability |
| `VENDOR_CONFIGURABLE` | Vendor can enable or disable per capability |
| `USER_DISCRETION` | Left to user discretion under guideline |
| `NOT_SEPARABLE` | Capabilities are integrated and cannot be separated |

### `CodeLicensing`

Rights attached to the software implementing the capability.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `NOT_STATED` | Source available with no licence attached |
| `PERMISSIVE_OPEN_SOURCE` | Permissive open-source licence |
| `COPYLEFT_OPEN_SOURCE` | Copyleft open-source licence |
| `RESTRICTED_USE` | Source available under use restrictions |
| `CLOSED_SOURCE` | Source not available |
| `DEVELOPED_IN_HOUSE` | Developed in-house |

### `ModelOrigin`

Where a model came from.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `VENDOR_TRAINED` | Trained by the vendor |
| `OPEN_WEIGHTS` | Obtained as open weights |
| `DERIVED_FROM_OPEN_WEIGHTS` | Derived from open weights |
| `COMMERCIAL` | Commercial model |
| `DERIVED_FROM_COMMERCIAL` | Derived from a commercial model |

### `BYOPolicy`

Whether customers may supply their own models.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `NOT_SUPPORTED` | No bring-your-own support |
| `SPECIFIC_MODELS` | Specific supported models only |
| `ANY_MODEL` | Any model meeting stated characteristics |

### `TrainingDataSource`

Broad source types used to train or adapt a model.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `COMMERCIALLY_LICENSED` | Commercially licensed |
| `OPEN_SOURCE_LICENSED` | Open-source licensed |
| `PUBLIC_DOMAIN` | Public domain |
| `WEB_CRAWL` | Web crawl |
| `VENDOR_OWNED` | Vendor-owned |
| `ALGORITHMICALLY_GENERATED` | Algorithmically generated |
| `DISTILLED_FROM_MODEL` | Distilled from another model |

### `SourceCommitment`

How long the training-data arrangements are guaranteed to hold.

| Member | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `TOOL_LIFETIME` | For the lifetime of the tool |
| `LONG_TERM_SUPPORT` | For a long-term support period |
| `DATE_BOUND` | Until a stated date |
| `NONE_STATED` | No commitment stated |
